announce.text: Hive and EVM, together in the Keychain browser extension.
dapps.empty.body: Featured dApps will appear here as they are added to the directory.
dapps.empty.network.body: No dApps are featured for {network} yet. Other compatible dApps may still connect through Keychain.
dapps.empty.network.title: No dApps listed on {network} yet
dapps.empty.title: No dApps listed yet
dapps.subtitle: Explore featured Web3 dApps that implement Keychain. Here are some examples, not an exhaustive list.
dapps.title: Connect to your favorite dApps!
faq.mobile.answer: Not yet. EVM accounts and networks are currently only supported in the browser extension. The iOS and Android Apps only support Hive for the time being.
faq.mobile.question: Does Keychain Mobile support EVM?
faq.networks.answer: Hive, Ethereum, BNB Chain, Avalanche C-Chain, Arbitrum One, Base, Polygon PoS, and Optimism are included. Supported testnets are available, and other compatible EVM networks can be configured manually.
hero.subtitle: Manage your Hive and EVM accounts, connect to dApps, buy, sell and swap cryptos, with your keys always under your control.
demo.title: See Keychain in action.
demo.subtitle: Try a real wallet interaction, then explore how Keychain helps you manage accounts, assets, and swaps across Hive and EVM.
demo.connect.title: Connect with Keychain.
demo.connect.subtitle: Experience how Keychain connects to websites. Choose EVM or Hive and approve a request directly in the extension.
demo.evm.initial.title: Connect an EVM account
demo.evm.initial.body: Connect through Keychain to see your wallet address and current network. No transaction or message signature is required.
demo.evm.initial.help: Keychain will ask you to approve access to your account.
demo.evm.pending: Approve the connection request in Keychain.
demo.evm.unavailable.title: Keychain wasn’t detected
demo.evm.unavailable.body: Install or enable the Keychain browser extension, then try again.
demo.evm.unsupported.title: This Keychain version doesn’t support EVM connections
demo.evm.unsupported.body: Update the Keychain browser extension to a version with EVM support, then check again.
demo.evm.success.title: Connected to Keychain
demo.evm.success.body: Your account is connected to this page. No transaction was submitted.
demo.evm.success.revoke: To revoke a site’s access, manage connected sites in Keychain.
demo.evm.error.cancelled: Connection cancelled. You can try again whenever you’re ready.
demo.evm.error.pending: A Keychain request is already open. Complete or cancel it before trying again.
demo.evm.error.disconnected: The wallet connection was interrupted. Try connecting again.
demo.evm.error.unexpected: Keychain couldn’t complete the connection. Please try again.
demo.hive.initial.title: Try Keychain on Hive
demo.hive.initial.body: Check that Keychain is available, then try signing a message with your Hive account. Nothing is broadcast to the blockchain.
demo.hive.detected.title: Hive Keychain detected
demo.hive.detected.body: Keychain is available. You can now try signing a message with your Hive account.
demo.hive.username.label: Hive username
demo.hive.sign.help: Keychain will ask you to sign a short message using your posting key. This does not publish anything or change your account.
demo.hive.pending: Approve the message-signing request in Keychain.
demo.hive.unavailable.title: Hive Keychain wasn’t detected
demo.hive.unavailable.body: Install or enable the browser extension, then check again.
demo.hive.success.title: Message signed successfully
demo.hive.success.body: Keychain completed the message-signing request. Nothing was broadcast to Hive.
demo.hive.error.cancelled: Signing cancelled. No changes were made to your Hive account.
demo.hive.error.pending: A Keychain request is already open.
demo.hive.error.failed: Keychain couldn’t sign the message. Check that the account is available and the extension is unlocked.
demo.explore.title: Explore the wallet.
demo.explore.subtitle: Take a closer look at how Keychain helps you manage accounts, track assets, and choose swap routes—all from the browser extension.
demo.preview.accounts.title: One extension for Hive and EVM.
demo.preview.accounts.body: Manage Hive and EVM accounts from the same extension. Switch between accounts, select supported networks, and add other EVM-compatible chains when you need them.
demo.preview.portfolio.title: Keep track of your assets.
demo.preview.portfolio.body: Review balances, supported tokens, NFTs, and transaction history from your wallet. When you want to exchange assets, swaps are accessible directly from Portfolio.
demo.preview.swaps.title: Compare routes before you swap.
demo.preview.swaps.body: Explore available swap and cross-network routes, review Keychain’s recommendation, and choose an alternative when one is available. Check the provider, estimated output, and costs before approving.
security.dependencies.body: Additional protections isolate third-party dependencies and help limit what they can access inside the extension.
security.dependencies.title: Extra safeguards for third-party code
security.encryption.body: Your wallet credentials are encrypted locally. Keychain doesn’t keep a copy of your private keys or recovery phrases, so keeping a secure backup is your responsibility.
security.encryption.title: Encrypted on your device
security.ledger.body: Use a compatible Ledger hardware wallet with Hive accounts and EVM accounts in the browser extension.
security.ledger.title: Ledger support for Hive and EVM
security.opensource.body: {extension} and {mobile} source code are public for inspection and contribution.
security.opensource.title: Open-source software
security.permissions.body: Review and remove sites connected to your EVM accounts from the extension permissions screen.
security.permissions.title: Manage dApp connections
security.review.body: Keychain shows the request for your approval before signing. Always check the account, network, site, and operation details.
security.review.title: Review before you sign
security.subtitle: Keychain is self-custodial: you control the credentials that authorize every action.
security.title: Your wallet. Your keys.
